task.reason: Analysis artifact recorded; development is queued

result.summary: PR1 foundation is implemented; acceptance at the supplied SHA still requires controller verification of version-bound evidence.
basis: Inspected README.md, docs/acceptance-pr1.md, src/gongcao/runner.py, and src/gongcao/sandbox.py.

PR1 supports explicit task registration, read-only GitHub synchronization, separate SQLite stages and execution states, independent Codex contexts, Worktrees, structured events, status/result inspection, and cancellation.

Runner creates the Worktree before agent execution, verifies sandbox access, records failures/cancellation, and leaves stage transitions to the controller. Bubblewrap enforces role-based workspace permissions with real OS access probes.

Existing acceptance documentation reports 43 passing tests and a successful real read-only Codex run, but binds that evidence to ee7d97bcc25d4a48f0be612a803194862c292431 rather than the supplied target SHA.
The sandbox's intentionally masked .git prevented independent checkout-SHA verification. No tests, credential access, implementation, or network mutations were performed.
next_steps: Controller should confirm the checkout and acceptance evidence correspond to the supplied target SHA.
Verify recorded checks and a real Codex run at that SHA demonstrate stage/result/log queries, actual role and credential isolation, and explicit failure/cancellation records.
Keep PR2/PR3 capabilities outside this PR1 acceptance decision; this report does not satisfy controller gates.
